name: Create Agreement
overview: An agreement defines pricing, billing and service terms for a hotel. I will create one for the selected hotel and walk you through each field.

fields.label: Agreement Type
fields.explanation: RENTAL_LAUNDRY is for hotels renting linen from you. LAUNDRY is for wash-only customers who own their linen.
fields.tips: The type you choose changes which fields appear below.

fields.label: Start Date
fields.explanation: The date the agreement becomes active. Billing and pricing take effect from this day.

fields.label: End Date
fields.explanation: The date the agreement expires. Renew before this date to avoid service interruption.

fields.label: Status
fields.explanation: Only ACTIVE agreements are used for order pricing and billing.

fields.label: Total Rooms
fields.explanation: Total number of rooms in the hotel. Used for rental capacity planning.

fields.label: Occupancy Rate
fields.explanation: Expected average occupancy in percent. Used to estimate linen usage.

fields.label: Deposit Amount
fields.explanation: Security deposit collected for rented linen. Refunded at agreement end.

fields.label: Credit Days
fields.explanation: Number of credit days allowed for rental invoices.

fields.label: Linen Delivery Days
fields.explanation: How many days per week linen is delivered to the hotel.

fields.label: Service Frequency
fields.explanation: How often pickup and delivery service is performed.

fields.label: Credit Term Days
fields.explanation: Credit period for laundry invoices.

fields.label: Pickup Frequency Days
fields.explanation: How often laundry is picked up from the hotel.

fields.label: Delivery TAT Days
fields.explanation: Turnaround time in days from pickup to delivery.

fields.label: Discount Percentage
fields.explanation: Discount applied on laundry billing.

fields.label: Billing Cycle
fields.explanation: Billing cycle in months. 1 = monthly.

fields.label: Billing Start Day
fields.explanation: Day of month when billing period starts.

fields.label: Billing End Day
fields.explanation: Day of month when billing period ends.

fields.label: Billing Type
fields.explanation: FLEXIBLE uses price list per item. FIXED uses a flat monthly amount.

fields.label: Fixed Monthly Amount
fields.explanation: Flat amount charged per month when billing type is FIXED.

subForms.name: Price Item
subForms.explanation: Add products with quantity, price and service type for this agreement.
subForms.explanationForMultiple: Let me add a second price item to show you.

fields.label: Product
fields.explanation: Select the linen product. List comes from your product catalog.

fields.label: Quantity
fields.explanation: Quantity of this product covered under the agreement.

fields.label: Price
fields.explanation: Unit price for this product and service type.

fields.label: Service Type
fields.explanation: Type of service applied to this product.

fields.label: Remarks
fields.explanation: Optional notes for this price line.

wrapUp: That completes the agreement setup. You have seen agreement type, dates, commercial terms and price list. This was a demo, data will be cleared. You can now create a real agreement for this hotel.
